itemdesc-bait-spinner: A flashing blade that runners chase down: carp, salmon, mackerel and tuna. Rarely lost when a fish is landed.
itemdesc-bait-popper: A topwater lure that splashes across the surface. Draws strikes from jumpers: trout, bass, mahi-mahi and arapaima.
itemdesc-bait-jig: A heavy jig bounced along the bottom. Bulldogs that hug the bottom take it: catfish, sheatfish, grouper and sturgeon.
itemdesc-bait-spoon: A wobbling metal spoon that triggers ambush strikes from pike, pickerel, barracuda and piranha.
itemdesc-fishingline-braided: Craft onto a fishing pole. The line holds under strain a little longer before snapping.
itemdesc-fishingline-waxed: Craft onto a fishing pole. Waxed braid holds under strain much longer before snapping.
itemdesc-fishingreel-copper: Craft onto a fishing pole to wind line in 10% faster.
itemdesc-fishingreel-iron: Craft onto a fishing pole to wind line in 20% faster.
hud-controls: Hold [RMB] to Reel  •  Release on surges
